editorial.blurb: Kama is a warmly helmed Indian restaurant in La Grange where exceptional cocktails, knowledgeable servers, and deeply flavored dishes—from butter masala to Kerala curries—make every visit feel like coming home.
editorial.insiderTip: Go on a quiet Friday afternoon for a relaxed experience and ask your server (the team here is notably knowledgeable) for recommendations that match your mood—they excel at customizing suggestions to your cravings and dietary needs.

topDishes.note: A returning favorite that reviewers describe as the best they've had in years
